forbiddenOutcome.description: A model output claims txHash/logIndex while declared before the FlowPulse receipt boundary.

invariant: A machine event cannot claim receipt-only facts before the FlowPulse receipt boundary happens-before the event.
title: retrocausal receipt claim
whyFlowPulseMatters: The impossible claim depends on receipt-only fields that appear after the transaction lands, not during hook execution.
